entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker and champion of Heliod who slays Xenagos and is betrayed and killed by Heliod.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Leonin planeswalker who accompanies Elspeth into Nyx.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: Usurper satyr-god who elevated himself to godhood.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: Goddess imprisoned by Xenagos's revelry and freed by Elspeth and Ajani.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: Sun-god and Elspeth's patron who strikes her down with Godsend.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God of the dead who gives Elspeth an ordeal and trades Daxos's soul for hers.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: Elspeth's beloved, condemned by her hand.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: Merfolk planeswalker who masqueraded as the mariner Callaphe.

entities.name: King Brimaz
entities.description: King who aids Elspeth and Ajani in securing passage.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: God whose wrath the travelers narrowly avoid.

entities.name: Polukranos
entities.description: Nylea's hydra, slain by Elspeth.

entities.name: Godsend
entities.description: Elspeth's divine weapon, used to kill Xenagos and then to strike her down.

entities.name: Monsoon
entities.description: Legendary ship that carries them to the edge of the world.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane where these events occur.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The divine starry realm of the gods.

entities.name: Nykthos
entities.description: Site where Heliod strikes Elspeth down.

entities.name: Oreskos
entities.description: Place in the Mortal Realm where Elspeth dies.

entities.name: Ilysia
entities.description: Mortal paradise of the Underworld where Elspeth's soul descends.

entities.name: Nessian Wood
entities.description: Wilderness where Elspeth reunites with Ajani.

entities.name: Temple of Mystery
entities.description: Gateway to Nyx.

entities.name: Great Revel
entities.description: Event after which Elspeth fled into the wilderness.

entities.name: Deicide in Nyx
entities.description: The climactic event of Xenagos's fall and Elspeth's martyrdom.

events.summary: After the Great Revel Elspeth flees to the Nessian Wood and reunites with Ajani.
events.quote: There, she found an unexpected reunion with the leonin Ajani Goldmane .

events.summary: With King Brimaz's aid they sail on the Monsoon, meet Kiora posing as Callaphe, avoid Thassa and reach the gateway to Nyx.
events.quote: narrowly avoided the wrath of Thassa to reach the gateway to Nyx at the Temple of Mystery

events.summary: Erebos tests Elspeth with an illusion of a family life; she smashes the golden cup and enters Nyx.
events.quote: By smashing the illusion’s golden cup, she proved her resolve and gained entry to the starry realm of the gods.

events.summary: They free the imprisoned Nylea and fight Xenagos; Elspeth thrusts Godsend into his chest, ending his godhood.
events.quote: Elspeth thrust Godsend into the satyr-god's chest, exploding the arrowhead and rending his heart apart

events.summary: Elspeth asks Erebos to trade her soul for Daxos's, and he agrees.
events.quote: Erebos agreed, pleased to claim the soul of a mortal who dared slay a god.

events.summary: Heliod seizes Godsend and strikes Elspeth down at Nykthos.
events.quote: he seized her divine weapon, Godsend , and struck her down with it.

events.summary: Ajani carries Elspeth's body to Oreskos, where she dies and her soul descends to Ilysia.
events.quote: the godslayer finally died and her soul descended into Ilysia

events.summary: Elspeth's sacrifice inspires mortal shrines and veneration across Theros.
events.quote: Mortal shrines sprang up in her name
